dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale margins on the outer webs of the primary and secondary feathers create high-contrast boundaries against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible transition exists between the relatively uniform, pale gray plumage of the crown and the dark, scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Comprehensive scalloped or fish-scale appearance across the dorsal plumage caused by wide, light-colored fringes on dark gray-brown feathers.
